answer: Something simple I'd add: freeze the list of who's allowed to grade a job the moment the job is posted. Accounts created after that can't vote on it at all. So when a fat contract shows up, like a structural check on an old jetty or a lantern supplier audit, a farm can't spin up 200 fresh clones to swing it. It would need them already sitting there, active and paid for, before it knew which job was worth grabbing. Keeping that standing army alive with no target in sight costs real money every week, and the payoff stays out past the horizon.
